description: Create one new address on a domain (adds a single local part). On a `catchall` domain the address delivers immediately; on a `rules` domain the route table is updated. This is the only write the agent surface owns — it cannot change the routing mode, delete an address, or edit the table.

localPart.description: The local part to create, e.g. `billing` for `billing@example.com`.

name: create_address
